name: release_sbom

test_list.description: A Cargo metadata graph emits every resolved package once and preserves dependency edges as SPDX DEPENDS_ON relationships.
Workspace members are identified and document provenance carries the workspace root and BLAKE3 Cargo.lock digest in the SPDX-supported checksum field.
Missing Cargo license metadata is represented as NOASSERTION rather than a guessed license.
Repeated serialization of identical Cargo metadata and lock bytes produces byte-identical SPDX JSON without generated timestamps.
Writing an SBOM does not replace an existing output file unless the caller explicitly requests replacement.
If replacement fails, the existing destination remains intact and the temporary output does not replace it.
Impossible month, day, hour, minute, or second values cannot be serialized as an SPDX creation timestamp.
Duplicate package identities fail closed instead of overwriting an earlier package.
A dependency graph node without a corresponding Cargo package fails closed.
A dependency edge to a missing Cargo package fails closed instead of being omitted.
The release artifact is rejected if exact Cargo.lock bytes differ before and after cargo metadata runs.

inputs.name: cargo_metadata
inputs.description: Full cargo metadata output generated with --locked --offline.

inputs.name: lock_bytes
inputs.description: Exact bytes of the workspace Cargo.lock used to derive the BLAKE3 checksum.

inputs.name: created
inputs.description: Explicit real UTC creation timestamp included as an input so output remains deterministic for identical inputs.

output_description: Deterministic SPDX 2.3 JSON bytes describing the resolved Cargo dependency graph, package source and workspace provenance.
